title: The Fano plane is the only uniform law that contradicts itself
claim: (1) With non-constant uniform signs (every line the same pattern on its positions g, gx, gxy) the all-zero assignment satisfies every line of a Cayley law. (2) Brace lemma: if a cubic triple system whose lines have three distinct points has an automorphism group transitive on its points and on its lines, its incidence graph has no nontrivial tight cut; by modularity two translates of a smallest tight shore share at most one point, so every line lies in exactly one translate, and counting then forces a shore of two points and one line, which a line of three points cannot have. (3) Hence, by the dictionary of THREEFOLD-SPACES-20261030-001A (not 2-colourable iff the digraph D(H, M) has no even dicycle) and McCuaig's theorem (the only strongly 2-connected digraph with no even dicycle is F7), such a system is not 2-colourable only if it is the Fano plane. So among uniform laws with uniform signs, the Fano plane is the only one whose knot is unsatisfiable.
failure_conditions: A Cayley law with non-constant uniform signs whose all-zero assignment violates a line.
A point- and line-transitive simple cubic triple system with a nontrivial tight cut.
A non-2-colourable point- and line-transitive simple cubic triple system other than the Fano plane.
A misreading of McCuaig's theorem or of the brace / strong 2-connectivity equivalence.
foundation_claim_scope: Every simple cubic triple system with a group of automorphisms transitive on points and on lines (every Cayley law), by proof; checked on a census of Cayley laws: cyclic laws up to 30 points, abelian, dihedral, A4, S4, A5, S5, PSL(2,7), wallpaper quotients and random 2-generated subgroups of S_5..S_7.

validation.status: by hand, with McCuaig's theorem as a cited input; finite claims checked by computation with controls; no human or external review
validation.novelty: known-with-delta: McCuaig's characterization (2000) and Seymour's dictionary are classical; the brace lemma for point- and line-transitive systems and the resulting classification of uniform contradictions are new as far as found (folklore risk moderate: symmetric bipartite graphs are often shown to be braces).
